description: React component for the Host Dashboard page managing auctions, items, winners, and real-time bidding analytics in a Web UI.

methods.name: refreshHighBid
methods.description: Fetches and updates the highest bid for a specific item.

methods.name: refreshAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches analytics data: highest bids, bid counts, and bid time series.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads list of items and initiates high bid refresh for each.

methods.name: loadEvent
methods.description: Fetches the event details based on eventId.

methods.name: refreshWinnersIfClosed
methods.description: Fetches winners if the event is closed.

methods.name: handleAddItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the auction.

methods.name: handleDeleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item from the auction.

methods.name: handleCloseItem
methods.description: Closes bidding for a specific item and determines its winner.

methods.name: handleOpen
methods.description: Opens the auction, changing its status.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the auction, fetches winners, and triggers confetti animation.

methods.name: exportCsv
methods.description: Exports the winners data as CSV file.
